<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex07052025-05-1316-41-09" status="reviewed"> <milestone unit="section" n="Incipit (1b1)"/>
         <milestone unit="section" n="Invocation (1b1)"/>
         <pb n="1b"/><lb n="1b1"/> || <rs type="deity">bcom ldan 'das ma pham pa</rs> la phyag tshal lo || <note type="translation">I bow down to the Fortunate one, the Invincible one (i.e., Maitreya).</note>
         <milestone unit="section" n="Introductory verses (1b1–1b3)"/>
         <milestone unit="section" n="v. 1"/>
         <lg><l>gang gis rang gi rang bzhin dri med 'khor ba'i khong gnas pa ||</l>
         <l>zab yangs skyob pa'i gsung dang zag med zhi ba'i lam brten pas ||</l>
         <l>legs rtogs sgrib myed blo mnga' rgya che 'od zer stong 'bar ba ||</l>
         <l>zhi ba'i 'khor lo dam pas tshogs rnams rmin mdzad <lb n="1b2"/> de la gus pas 'dud ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">I respectfully bow down to the one (i.e. Maitreya) who abides in the saṃsāra with his stainless own-nature, who, depending both on the extensive and profond teachings of the protector (i.e. the Buddha) and on the uncontaminated path, who hence has the unobstructed wisdom of realization, who shines forth with thousands of extensive rays, and who brings to maturation groups (of beings) by means of the excellent wheel of pacification.</note>
        <seg type="excerpt" xml:id="ex7052023-07-1814-08-32" status="reviewed"> <milestone unit="section" n="v. 2"/>
        <lg> <l>brtse chen blo gros ldan ba lta ngan sgra gcan las grol zhing || </l>
         <l>chos kyi snang pa mchog gis blo ngan rab rib rnams bsal te ||</l>
         <l>sa stengs 'di na nyi bzhin grags pa lham me snang gyur pa ||</l><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3805">zla myed <choice><corr>rigs par smra ba</corr><sic>rigs pas smra ba</sic></choice> chos gyi bla ma</rs> dpal <choice><reg>la</reg><orig>‹la›</orig></choice> 'dud ||</l></lg>
      <note type="translation">I bow down to the auspicious (Zhang tshe spong) Chos kyi bla ma, the matchless logician who, having great compassion and intelligence, is freed from the eclipse maker (Rāhu) of wrong views, and who eliminates eye-diseases (timira) of the bad-minded people by means of excellent light of teaching, and briliantly shining forth on the earth with a sun-like glory.</note></seg>
               
         <milestone unit="section" n="v. 3"/>
    <lg>     <l>ma pham rgyal sras dam pa'i zhal gyi bum pa bzang po nas ||</l>
         <l>mngon 'byung theg <lb n="1b3"/> mchog nges <choice><corr>don</corr><sic>dan</sic></choice> dam chos bdud rtsi dri myed pa ||</l>
         <l>blo ngan <choice><corr>rlom</corr><sic>rlob</sic></choice> pa'i yid can ngan skyugs dri mas ma lcags shing ||</l>
         <l>'gro ba'i mi shes nad gsol 'jig rten 'di na rigs gnas rgyal ||||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">May this stainless nectar — he excellent teaching of definitive meaning of the excellent vehicle, which has arisen from the auspicious vessel of the excellent Son of the victorious one, the Invicible (Ajita, Maitreya) — not be saturated with stains of the vomit of evil of the bad-minded ones, who have a conceited mind, and may it cure the disease of ignorance of the beings, 
         And may it prevail in this world (as) the foundation that is spiritual disposition (gotra).</note>
      </seg></TEI>
